messages.subject: Harris | GCC Energy & Mining Executive Profile | ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Karaolides,

I am sharing my profile for senior GCC leadership mandates across energy, mining, minerals, natural resources and government-facing corporate functions.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio covers government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My current exposure also includes a large renewable-energy platform supporting mining operations, with approximately 46-50 MWp of solar and more than 80 MWh of battery storage.

InterSearch Middle East's Energy practice covers mining and minerals, renewable energy and natural resources, making my profile directly relevant to senior searches where country-facing leadership, sustainability and stakeholder execution intersect.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track mandates across External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Social Performance and Country Leadership. Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE.

I have attached a GCC-focused executive CV for confidential consideration. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
